title: Understanding the Logistic Function
text: The logistic function, also known as the sigmoid function, is used to model probabilities. It transforms any real-valued number into a value between $$0$$ and $$1$$. The formula is given by $$sigma(z)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$.

title: Calculate the Linear Combination
text: To find the value of $$z$$ in the logistic function, calculate the linear combination of the features and the parameters: $$z=\theta_1 hue+\theta_2 abv$$. Substitute the given values for hue and abv.

title: Compute the Probability
text: Once you have the value of $$z$$, use the logistic function to compute the probability gamma. Remember, $$gamma=sigma(z)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$.

text: What is the value of gamma when $$z=\frac{-3}{2}$$? Use the formula $$gamma=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$.
